_about: Grammar Lab's own grouping, written by hand (see scripts/grammar-lab-build.js). bands: in order, each with its units (pathways) in order. pathways: a unit's title and its parts, each part an ordered list of topic ids (a topic opens when the one before it in the unit is mastered). topics: each topic once, by id: where its text is in source/course.md (the band section and the topic heading), its quiz format, the line that asks the question, and its levels (questions per level). scripts/grammar-lab-build.js reads this with source/course.md and writes topics.json.
